selection.name: agent-browser (C06)
selection.role: Capability-fit choice for bounded URL retrieval and page interaction; measured superiority remains unresolved.
selection.install_command:
npm install -g agent-browser@0.38.2
agent-browser install --with-deps
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-browser

basis.shows: Documents HTTP retrieval through read URL without launching Chrome, rendered-tab reading, browser interaction, URL/title inspection, output limits and timeouts. Explicitly documents Linux x64 and macOS arm64 binaries, Linux dependency installation, and Claude Code/Codex skills. This breadth supports the capability-fit preference.
Configures Rust tests, launcher tests, native browser E2E tests and installation checks. Current passing run results were not verified.
Provides a reproducible latency, startup and memory benchmark comparing its Node and Rust daemons. It does not compare competing repositories or establish WSL2 research superiority.
Unarchived; Apache-2.0 license. Open-issue count includes pull requests and does not establish responsiveness.
Default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026, within 90 days.
Release published October 1, 2026, with issue-linked fixes supporting ongoing maintenance.

not_selected.name: Playwright CLI
not_selected.reason: Very close alternative with navigation, interaction, URL/title output, snapshots and cross-platform CI; agent-browser additionally documents browser-free URL reading and explicit macOS arm64/Codex support. No measured head-to-head winner is established. [README](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/blob/b85c7a736bb473bf55b584e54a09ffa698d6d871/README.md), [tests](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/blob/b85c7a736bb473bf55b584e54a09ffa698d6d871/tests/integration.spec.ts), [CI](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/blob/b85c7a736bb473bf55b584e54a09ffa698d6d871/.github/workflows/ci.yml).

not_selected.name: Browser Use
not_selected.reason: Credible local CLI/MCP alternative with regression tests; its caller-supplied Python/browser-harness interface is less direct for this requirement than the selected CLI's URL-reading and atomic interaction commands. Comparative coverage remains unmeasured. [CLI](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use/blob/302d8fcb245a7a63fb7531a4734c9ce3c7792779/browser_use/cli.py), [tests](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use/blob/302d8fcb245a7a63fb7531a4734c9ce3c7792779/tests/ci/test_browser_use_cli.py).

not_selected.name: Cua Driver
not_selected.reason: Offers a native CLI/MCP and documented desktop test matrix, but its OS-specific GUI focus provides weaker verified fit for attributable web retrieval; WSL2 operation remains unverified. [Driver README](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/352507b6c03162ab286b21d5ed509125cc3daece/libs/cua-driver/README.md), [test matrix](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/352507b6c03162ab286b21d5ed509125cc3daece/libs/cua-driver/docs/test-matrix.md).

not_selected.name: trafilatura
not_selected.reason: Strong conditional extractor: upstream reports F-score 0.924 for version 2.2.0 on 990 documents, but that measures text extraction, not source discovery, citation accuracy or interaction; no demonstrated native extraction failure warrants adding it. [Evaluation](https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura/blob/96e19b949c3ac4a9e193b41fe2fb352e7150db86/docs/evaluation.rst), [method and limitations](https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura/blob/96e19b949c3ac4a9e193b41fe2fb352e7150db86/tests/README.rst).

not_selected.name: Crawl4AI
not_selected.reason: Its standalone CLI supports bounded crawling without a standing server, but the packet supplies no demonstrated native-source coverage miss justifying this additional crawler. [README](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/blob/e5d2e786d1a101225f3f6a3e6fd344d76eeb13af/README.md).

not_selected.name: Tavily CLI
not_selected.reason: Provides bounded search/extraction commands, keyless access and agent skills, but adds a research service without demonstrated native-coverage failure; its documented command set does not supply general page interaction. [README](https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-cli/blob/fd745230e6756933e3a190bfdc61ea1eb2db3993/README.md).

not_selected.name: exa-mcp-server
not_selected.reason: Documents search/fetch MCP tools and Claude Code/Codex integration, but service-backed discovery is conditional under the packet's deciding rule, and no native-coverage failure is established. [README](https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server/blob/f3d71fb6b0ff4b4683f108f05bc2bae61a9f7e97/README.md).

not_selected.name: Firecrawl MCP
not_selected.reason: Capable scraping/search MCP with hosted and self-hosted paths, but no demonstrated native-coverage miss warrants the additional service. Free and self-hosted options prevent a paid-service exclusion. [README](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server/blob/8fd13724c9da7a859d7bf95e735bb8b462de2c0c/README.md).

excluded.name: OpenResearch
excluded.fact: The documented product manages parallel research-agent sessions, experiments, worktrees and a local dashboard through orx up; this conflicts with the requirement to avoid another standing research-agent stack. [README](https://github.com/alphaXiv/OpenResearch/blob/ee36ef0333ca3c533eace915f1bec322a1efde1c/README.md).

layers.deciding_comparison: Compare agent-browser v0.38.2 against Playwright CLI v0.1.22 and Browser Use's inspected CLI at commit 302d8fcb245a7a63fb7531a4734c9ce3c7792779 on clean WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64. Freeze required primary-source URLs, citation checks and interactions, including static pages, redirects, long documents, authenticated pages and JavaScript-rendered content. Under equal command/time/output budgets, measure source coverage, correct final URL/title attribution, citation entailment, interaction completion, extraction fidelity, latency, agent-visible tokens and cleanup. Repeat essential cases on macOS arm64. Add a crawler or research service only when it remedies a reproducible native-coverage failure. The selection above is a documented capability-fit preference, not a measured performance victory.
evidence_gaps: The packet contains no comparison where every named arm ran; inspected upstream benchmarks do not settle this requirement on the target hosts.
Upstream test suites and CI configurations were inspected, but current CI run conclusions were not verified.

Clean WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution was not performed. Agent-browser documents matching binaries; target-host reliability remains unmeasured. This browser/HTTP requirement does not require the RTX 4090.

All ten repositories were unarchived and had default-branch commits within 90 days as observed October 2, 2026. Issue response activity was not verified; open-issue counts were not used as quality scores.

Firecrawl MCP's latest GitHub release is September 26, 2025, despite active default-branch commits. Tavily CLI and Exa returned HTTP 404 from releases/latest, which does not establish absence of package releases. Cua's latest release belongs to Spaces rather than Driver.

The session approval policy rejected ctx_fetch_and_index with: 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Pinned public Git source files were instead indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search. Consequently, the requested webpage-fetch method could not be completed.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, zero web searches, and one rejected batch requesting eight page fetches; no webpage content was returned.
